name: Dokitale: Last Goodbye to the Literature Club
summary: This fan-game is about the battle with Monika that we face along the path of Genocide. This is a story about how the girls from DDLC game mysteriously got into the game of Undertale. But after the fall, Frisk decided to follow the path of Genocide.... Will you decide to finish your path... or maybe you'll change your mind... player?
